name: workflow-manager
description: Quality-first, context-efficient workflow management with daily/work domain classification, adaptive routing, compaction recovery, and dynamic subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Classify intent, protect reasoning quality, and manage workflows.
interface.longDescription: Separates daily requests from engineering work before routing complexity, keeps daily tasks on the current model, preserves required reasoning and evidence, resumes across compaction, and dynamically delegates positive-utility independent lanes.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager: keep only relevant stages while preserving required reasoning, evidence, correction, and verification.
Correctness and acceptance evidence outrank context savings; checkpoint before compaction and remove only redundancy.
For complex work, optimize expected wall-clock time; delegate positive-utility owned lanes and serialize only real conflicts.
